prompt.value: There are two stores, A and B, which sell t-shirts on the market. The store A has stock of n red and 2 black t-shirts and the store B has a stock of 2 red and n black t-shirts. Given that both the t-shirts purchased are red, the probability that they were purchased from store A is f, find the value of n.
